title: Ass in the Woods
author: Alice Vartevanian
description:
Who wakes in the woods from a nap on midsummer night? You! Naturally, fae shenanigans ensue!

You're a stranger in this short, chaotic comedy about success, failure, and the self-worth of a half-ass-half-man. But even a stranger's words can be influential.

Inspired by and based on William Shakespeare’s Midsummer Night’s Dream.

Images: Collages made by author using free license images. Background made by author using MS Paint.
